Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1671612 (Cytochrome b-c1 complex subunit 7). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
